items.title: Thanks for making the lives of communicators easier!
items.description: It is incredible to look back five years and recall how life was like before Vibe – so many more steps, so much more inefficiencies!

items.title: You can just have it all on Vibe.
items.description: Even when you’re at home, you can have these snackable bits of content you can retain, instead of having to check an email, look at an announcement, go from one platform to another.

items.title: Before Vibe there was a lot of 'printed flyers' which is both costly and environmentally unfriendly.
items.description: With Vibe's on-screen format it’s easy to make changes instantly on the fly without the need for a reprint. No more excuses from staff not reading internal emails. Messaging is right there, on the sc…

items.title: We have found Vibe very effective as an implementation model for dashboard content.
items.description: It helps us visualise data. It’s a great system and I would definitely recommend it.

items.title: Vibe helps us get internal messaging to staff in a fun, graphic format.
items.description: As well as the serious stuff, slideshows of staff events are very popular. Plus, promote our outward-facing social media content inwardly to staff and visitors.

items.title: We are now able to share general company information and specific site information to large groups of people.
items.description: It suits our teams and contractors in different locations, which in the past has been difficult to communicate with.

items.title: Really great for providing snackable and understandable content, it’s visually a great way to communicate.
items.description: The impact when people see our big digital wall at reception is great.

items.title: We easily share information to staff in all locations that isn't always available to them.
items.description: The different templates are a bonus - there's always a layout that works.

items.title: It's very cool and a great way to communicate with and engage my non-wired employees.
items.description: The digital templates are extensive and the Vibe team support is outstanding. The feedback I get from my team tells me we're on the right track.

items.title: This software has helped stop geographical office separation and team silos.
items.description: Meetings are shorter. We get immediate reporting to the whole business on performance without having to send more emails to get the data required.

items.title: We started with COVID messages, but after 6 months, we were communicating other business events on site.
items.description: We're using Vibe for EVERYTHING. Facebook groups, café menus, surveys (with a QR code), internal videos, welcoming our summer interns, Christmas messaging from our CEO + more!
